Why choose Miles & Memories?

While others charge fees and leave you to figure out the details, we handle everything from flights to fine dining reservations, all at no cost to you.

$0 Planning Fees

Our expert planning services are completely complimentary, funded by our industry partnerships. You get five-star service without the five-star price tag.

Detail Obsessed

From corporate incentive trips to friends and family getaways, we obsess over every detail to craft an experience that is uniquely yours.

Your Travel Partner

We're more than planners; available before, during, and after your trip. Think of us as your travel-savvy friend who happens to have industry connections!

Our Services

We offer comprehensive travel planning for every occasion and budget.

Corporate Travel & Events

Zero-investment planning for conferences, incentive trips, and business travel. We work with you or your existing event teams and handle everything from budget management to on-site support.

Learn More

Greek Life Adventures

Spring break, formals, and group reunions made simple. Send us your group list, and we handle payment plans, itineraries, and even packing lists for groups up to 100+.

Learn More

Family & Group Travel

Work with experts who know every Disney & Universal Skip-the-Line hack, cruise specialists who book the perfect cabin, and itinerary masters for overseas adventures with grandparents and toddlers alike.

Learn More

Luxury Experiences

Private jets, exclusive resorts, African safaris, and door-to-door concierge service for travelers who want extraordinary adventures with everything planned and taken care of.

Learn More

How it works

Just four simple steps to your best trip ever.

1

Free Discovery Call

Tell us your vision, budget, and must-haves. No sales pitch - just us getting to know what makes you tick.

2

We Handle It all

Flights, hotels, activities, payment plans, dining reservations - everything you'd rather not think about.

3

Review & Approve

We present your complete itinerary with options. You choose what works, and we book it all.

4

Travel Worry-Free

Enjoy your trip knowing we're a text away if anything needs adjusting.

Meet Mandy: Your Travel Powerhouse

After watching too many friends stress over vacation planning and companies waste money on poorly planned corporate events, Mandy created Miles & Memories to be the travel partner she wished existed.

Working through Travelmation's network, she brings industry connections and insider knowledge to every trip, whether it's a Disney vacation with three generations or a 200-person corporate retreat.
